title: HamZaboon Issue Registry
description: Canonical schema for issues/issues.json records. Validated programmatically by issues/validate.py.

title.description: Brief issue title in Persian or English

func.description: Specific function, class, or table name

category.description: Issue category for filtering and dashboard grouping

note.description: Additional context, rationale, or accepted-risk justification

resolved.description: Derived from status; true when status == 'resolved'

detailOpen.description: UI state: whether the detail panel is expanded

editing.description: UI state: whether the record is being edited

roadmap_refs.description: Roadmap anchor IDs or feature area labels

evidence.description: Concrete evidence pointing to symbols, behavior, or documentation

last_reviewed.description: Date of last review in YYYY-MM-DD format

decision_refs.description: IDs of locked decisions in project_status.json that this issue relates to

depends_on.description: Issue IDs that this record depends on
